title: Scuba Diving Common Cylinder Types Database
description: A collection of common scuba diving cylinder types and their specifications.

$schema.description: The URI of the schema for validation

version.description: Semantic or date-based dataset release tag (e.g., '2025.10').

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when this dataset was generated.

commonName.description: Common display name for the cylinder

ratedCapacityCuft.description: Marketed cu ft rating (the number in the name, e.g. 80 for an AL80), for cuft-named tanks only. The displayed size is the real deliverable gas, which can differ. Omitted for metric-named tanks.

emptyWeightKg.description: Weight in air of the empty cylinder in kg, without the valve. Buoyancy includes a valve and this does not: see docs/DATASETS.md.

buoyancyKg.description: Buoyancy in sea water (1.025 kg/L) with a standard valve fitted (the basis of the Luxfer spec sheet; Faber's sheets quote it without a valve). A consumer that models other water converts with the volume the cylinder displaces, not waterVolumeL. Full method in docs/DATASETS.md.

full.description: Net buoyancy in kg at workingPressureBar gauge: air with real-gas compressibility at 15 C, sea water, standard valve. Negative sinks.

at50bar.description: Net buoyancy in kg at 50 bar gauge: air with real-gas compressibility at 15 C, sea water, standard valve. Negative sinks.

empty.description: Net buoyancy in kg with no gas inside: sea water, standard valve (0.7 kg brass at 8.5 kg/L). Negative sinks.

brands.description: Common manufacturers or brands for this cylinder type
